import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date column to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Plot the total sales by product using a bar chart
sns.set()
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(x='product', y='total', data=coffee_sales, hue='size', dodge=True)
plt.title('Total Sales by Product and Size')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales')
plt.legend(title='Size')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
